tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nu la bstod pa bzhugs/

rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya mañju shrī ku mā ra stod tra na/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nu la bstod pa/ ngag gi dbang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shin tu yid 'ong mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /lha brgya'i gtsug gi pad+mas zhabs mchod cing*/ /kun mkhyen nyi zer gsal ba'i dbang po gang*/ /de ring bdag gi pad mtshor dgyes par mdzod/ /zhi ba'i nam mkha' rab tu yangs pa la/ /seng ge mchog dang pad+ma zla ba'i steng*/ /'jam dpal gzhon nu shin tu mdzes pa'i sku/ /yid 'ong mtshan dpes mdzes la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyon gyis ma gos pad+ma rā ga 'dra/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis ut+pal 'gying ba'i steng*/ /ral gri po ti mu med 'od zer 'phro/ /rdo rje skyil krung mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dbu rgyan snyan cha do shal dpung rgyan sogs/ /rin chen rgyan rnams kun nas 'khrol ba'i sku/ / zur phud lnga ldan dar gyi na bza' mdzes/ /snyan gong ut+pal 'phur la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nyid mdun gnas pad sdong yangs pa'i steng*/ /ston ka'i zla ba shin tu dri med la/ /zhi ba'i lha mo shin tu mdzes pa'i sku/ /rin chen rgyan rnams rdzogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ut+pal gzhon nu lta bu'i dbyangs can mchog / zhal gcig phyag gnyis ral gri po sti bsnams/ /rdo rje skyil krung rab tu zhi ba'i sku/ /'od zer dra ba 'gyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lta bas mi ngoms yid 'ong thugs rje'i lha/ /gcig tu ma nges snang la rang bzhin med/ /rgyal ba rgyal sras mang po'i sprin 'phro ba'i/ /'jam dpal yab yum snang la phyag 'tshal lo/ / sna tshogs nor bu'i snang bas mi bzlog pa'i/ /'od zer 'khrugs pas phyogs rnams snang mdzad cing*/ /thugs rje'i rnam 'phrul mtha' yas 'gyed pa'i lha/ / gti mug mun bral mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji snyed ji bzhin mkhyen pa'i 'od zer gyis/ /ma lus 'jig rten khams kun snang mdzad cing*/ /srid nas zhi bar 'gro ba 'dren pa'i lha/

/thabs mkhas thugs rje mnga' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de ltar snyan ngag me tog snyim bkang nas/ /mgon khyod bstod pa'i bsod nams gang yod des/ / 'gro kun yid kyi mun pa kun bsal te/ /'jam pa'i dpal du myur du 'grub par mdzod/ /'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nu la bstod pa mi'am ci'i dbyangs snyan ces bya ba mang du thos pa'i snyan dngags mkhan dpal ldan bsam yas pa tshul khrims blo gros kyis sbyar ba rdzogs so/ / dge'o// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (24) bstod tshogs kyi skor/ -PAGE 10--PAGE 9--PAGE 9-
